notes: Edge cases identified by auditing the actual implementation (backend/ and mobile/), not the README. 'status' records what is true in the code today: fixed = handled and covered by a test; handled = handled in code without a dedicated test; open = known gap.

edge_cases.case: MPIN shorter or longer than the backend allows
edge_cases.trigger: User enters a 3- or 7-digit MPIN at registration
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Reject client-side with the same rule the backend enforces (/^\d{4,6}$/); never invent a different policy

edge_cases.case: MPIN and confirmation do not match
edge_cases.trigger: Confirm field differs from the MPIN field
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Block submission and point at the confirmation field

edge_cases.case: Wrong credentials at login
edge_cases.trigger: Unknown mobile number, or a known number with the wrong MPIN
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Identical message for both, so the response never reveals which credential was wrong
edge_cases.user_message: Mobile number or MPIN is incorrect.

edge_cases.case: Access token expires mid-session
edge_cases.trigger: App reopened more than 15 minutes after the last call
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Silently refresh and retry the original request; only force sign-in when the 30-day refresh token is genuinely dead

edge_cases.case: Refresh endpoint itself returns 401
edge_cases.trigger: Refresh token revoked or expired
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Do not retry the refresh (it would loop); clear the session and prompt sign-in once

edge_cases.case: Registration rate limit reached
edge_cases.trigger: More than 10 registrations from one IP within an hour
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Surface the limit as a wait, never as a raw limiter payload
edge_cases.user_message: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.

edge_cases.case: Two accounts used on one device
edge_cases.trigger: User A signs out, user B signs in on the same phone
edge_cases.expected_behavior: None of A's cached dashboard, queued writes or session data is visible or usable to B
edge_cases.user_message: (none — isolation must be invisible and absolute)

edge_cases.case: Empty or whitespace-only title
edge_cases.trigger: Task saved with no title, or a voice command that only said "remind me to"
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Refuse to create; ask what the task is
edge_cases.user_message: What should I call this task?

edge_cases.case: Title longer than the 200-character schema limit
edge_cases.trigger: Long dictated sentence saved as a title
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Truncate on a word boundary rather than letting the database reject the write

edge_cases.case: Reminder time already in the past
edge_cases.trigger: "Remind me at 9am" said at 10am with no date given
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Roll to the next occurrence rather than scheduling a notification that can never fire

edge_cases.case: Explicitly dated task in the past
edge_cases.trigger: User names a past date deliberately (backfilling)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Honour the date exactly; never silently move a date the user stated

edge_cases.case: Double tap on Add Task or Save
edge_cases.trigger: Impatient tap on a slow connection
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Second press within the guard window is ignored, so no duplicate task is created

edge_cases.case: Completing a task twice
edge_cases.trigger: Rapid double tap on the completion circle
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Idempotent — final state matches the last intent, no error shown

edge_cases.case: Deleting a task that is already gone
edge_cases.trigger: Delete on a stale list, or a retried offline delete
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Treat the 404 as success — the desired end state is already true

edge_cases.case: Ambiguous task reference in a spoken command
edge_cases.trigger: "Delete call" when both "Call mom" and "Call dad" exist
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Never guess; list the candidates and ask which one. Nothing is deleted while the question stands
edge_cases.user_message: I found more than one match — which one?

edge_cases.case: Notification permission denied
edge_cases.trigger: User declines the notification prompt
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Task still saves; explain that reminders cannot appear and offer settings
edge_cases.user_message: Your phone won't be able to show reminders until notifications are enabled.

edge_cases.case: Task completed or deleted before its reminder fires
edge_cases.trigger: User finishes a task early
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Cancel the scheduled local notification so it never fires for something already done

edge_cases.case: Device timezone changes after a reminder is scheduled
edge_cases.trigger: User travels across timezones
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Reminder fires at the intended local wall-clock time; never display UTC to the user

edge_cases.case: Zero or negative amount
edge_cases.trigger: Transaction saved with 0 or a negative value
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Reject — the schema requires a positive amount
edge_cases.user_message: Enter an amount greater than zero.

edge_cases.case: Amount written with Indian grouping or scale words
edge_cases.trigger: "1,50,000", "5k", "2 lakh", "paanch sau"
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Parse to the correct value; prefer a currency-marked figure over an unrelated number in the same sentence

edge_cases.case: Spoken expense with no account named and several accounts existing
edge_cases.trigger: "Spent 500 on groceries" with both Home and Office set up
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Ask which account; never pick one on the user's behalf

edge_cases.case: Expense recorded before any account exists
edge_cases.trigger: First-run user says "spent 500 on groceries"
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Explain an account is needed and how to make one; save nothing
edge_cases.user_message: You'll need a finance account first — tell me a name, like "create account Home".

edge_cases.case: Financial action proposed while confirmation is enabled
edge_cases.trigger: Any assistant-initiated cash-in or cash-out
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Return a pending action and write nothing until the user confirms
edge_cases.user_message: Save ₹500 spent on Groceries in Home?

edge_cases.case: User declines a proposed transaction
edge_cases.trigger: Cancel tapped on the confirmation
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Nothing is written; say so plainly
edge_cases.user_message: No problem, I won't save that.

edge_cases.case: Ambiguous direction in a spoken amount
edge_cases.trigger: "Add 500" with no spend/receive verb
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Ask whether it is money received or an expense; do not guess a direction
edge_cases.user_message: Should I add ₹500 as money received or an expense?

edge_cases.case: Balance of exactly zero while data is still loading
edge_cases.trigger: Slow network on the money screen
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Show a skeleton, never a placeholder ₹0 — a zero balance is real information

edge_cases.case: Gemini API key missing
edge_cases.trigger: Backend deployed without GEMINI_API_KEY
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Rule engine still answers everyday commands; only unrecognised phrasing returns a clean 503
edge_cases.user_message: Your smart assistant isn't set up yet.

edge_cases.case: Model quota exhausted (429)
edge_cases.trigger: Free-tier limit of 20 generate_content requests reached
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Degrade to the rule engine and explain what still works; never surface a 500
edge_cases.user_message: I couldn't reach the AI service just now, so I can only handle direct commands.

edge_cases.case: Model reply carries a stale conversation id
edge_cases.trigger: A rule-handled turn returns a local id that is then sent back as previousInteractionId
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Strip local ids before calling the model — the API rejects ids it did not issue

edge_cases.case: Confirmation resolved for a rule-engine action
edge_cases.trigger: User confirms an expense that the rule engine proposed
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Execute locally; never replay a call id to a model that never issued it
edge_cases.user_message: Saved ₹500 out for Groceries in Home.

edge_cases.case: Out-of-scope question
edge_cases.trigger: "What's the weather tomorrow?"
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Decline locally without spending an API call, and redirect to what the app can do
edge_cases.user_message: I can only help with your tasks, reminders and finances in this app.

edge_cases.case: Model asked to touch data directly
edge_cases.trigger: Any assistant turn
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Only allowlisted, user-scoped, schema-validated tools run; no arbitrary queries reach the database

edge_cases.case: Microphone permission denied
edge_cases.trigger: User taps the microphone without permission
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Do not crash; explain the permission and offer both settings and typing
edge_cases.user_message: Microphone access is off. You can allow it in Settings or type instead.

edge_cases.case: Speech recognition unavailable on the device
edge_cases.trigger: Running under Expo Go, or a device with no recogniser
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Report it once and keep typing fully functional; never re-offer a microphone that cannot work
edge_cases.user_message: Voice isn't available on this device.

edge_cases.case: Speech stops mid-sentence
edge_cases.trigger: "Remind me to…" then silence
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Refuse to execute a dangling command; offer to try again
edge_cases.user_message: I didn't hear the full request.

edge_cases.case: Recognition result arrives after cancellation
edge_cases.trigger: User cancels while the recogniser is still finishing
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Ignore the late result; a cancelled session must not be revived and acted on

edge_cases.case: Second microphone tap while a session is running
edge_cases.trigger: Impatient double tap
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Ignore rather than starting a competing recogniser

edge_cases.case: Screen left while the microphone is live
edge_cases.trigger: User navigates away mid-listen
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Release the microphone so it does not block other apps or keep the recording indicator lit

edge_cases.case: Hindi and Hinglish commands
edge_cases.trigger: "Kal shaam 6 baje doodh lana yaad dilana" / "कल शाम 6 बजे दूध लाना याद दिलाना"
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Understand both scripts and reply in the same language the user used
edge_cases.user_message: "दूध लाना" कल शाम 6 बजे के लिए जोड़ दिया।

edge_cases.case: Ambiguous Hindi day word
edge_cases.trigger: "kal" means both yesterday and tomorrow; "parso" means both directions
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Resolve by intent — forward for scheduling, backward when logging something that already happened

edge_cases.case: New reply while the previous one is still speaking
edge_cases.trigger: User asks a second question immediately
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Stop the old utterance and speak the new one; never queue or overlap

edge_cases.case: Late callback from an interrupted utterance
edge_cases.trigger: onDone fires for speech that was already replaced
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Ignore it — a superseded utterance must not clear the newer one's speaking state

edge_cases.case: No audio route available
edge_cases.trigger: Silent mode, or Bluetooth disconnected mid-reply
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Fail quietly — the reply is already on screen

edge_cases.case: Task or transaction created with no network
edge_cases.trigger: Save attempted while offline
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Queue with a client-generated idempotency key and say clearly it is only on this phone so far
edge_cases.user_message: Saved on this phone. It will sync automatically when you're back online.

edge_cases.case: Request reached the server but the response was lost
edge_cases.trigger: Connection drops after the write committed
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Retry reuses the same idempotency key; the backend returns the original record instead of inserting again

edge_cases.case: Queued item belongs to a signed-out account
edge_cases.trigger: User A queues an expense, signs out, user B signs in and the queue flushes
edge_cases.expected_behavior: A's item must never be posted under B's session; queues are per-user and flushing requires a signed-in user

edge_cases.case: Queue left by an older app version under a shared key
edge_cases.trigger: Upgrade from a build that stored one queue for all users
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Discard rather than replay — the owner is unknowable and misattributing financial records is worse than losing unsynced entries

edge_cases.case: Server rejects a queued item on retry
edge_cases.trigger: Validation failure or deleted parent account
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Treat any real server response as resolved and drop the item; only genuine network failure keeps it queued

edge_cases.case: Corrupt queue payload in storage
edge_cases.trigger: Interrupted write, or manual storage tampering
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Parse failure yields an empty queue rather than crashing on launch

edge_cases.case: Fast typing produces out-of-order responses
edge_cases.trigger: Each keystroke issues a request and an early one resolves last
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Debounce, and discard any response that is not from the newest request

edge_cases.case: No results
edge_cases.trigger: Query matches nothing
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Say nothing matched and offer to clear, rather than showing an empty screen

edge_cases.case: Backend returns a database or driver error string
edge_cases.trigger: Unhandled MongoServerError, CastError, JWT error or Gemini failure
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Replace with plain language; implementation detail must never reach the screen
edge_cases.user_message: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

edge_cases.case: Request times out
edge_cases.trigger: Cold start on a free-tier host, or a slow multi-round assistant turn
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish a timeout from being offline, and offer a retry rather than an endless spinner
edge_cases.user_message: That's taking longer than expected. Please try again.

edge_cases.case: Database unreachable from the backend
edge_cases.trigger: Atlas allowlist change, or a restart during deploy
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Health check may stay green, but data routes must fail with a plain message rather than hanging
edge_cases.user_message: Your data service is temporarily unavailable.

edge_cases.case: Test suite pointed at a real database
edge_cases.trigger: MONGO_URI in .env points at a shared cluster and tests truncate collections after each test
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Under NODE_ENV=test, MONGO_URI is ignored and an in-memory database is used; the suite additionally asserts the host is local before deleting anything

edge_cases.case: Small screen with large system font
edge_cases.trigger: 320pt width with the OS text size increased
edge_cases.expected_behavior: No horizontal scrolling, no clipped buttons, labels wrap rather than truncate

edge_cases.case: Numeric keyboard covers the field being typed into
edge_cases.trigger: Entering an MPIN or an amount on a short screen
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Field and primary button stay visible and reachable

edge_cases.case: Icon-only control reached by a screen reader
edge_cases.trigger: VoiceOver or TalkBack focuses the search, calendar or microphone button
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Every icon-only control announces a meaningful label

edge_cases.case: Reduce Motion enabled
edge_cases.trigger: User turns on the OS reduce-motion setting
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Skeleton pulsing and other animation is suppressed

edge_cases.case: Secrets reaching the mobile bundle
edge_cases.trigger: Any EXPO_PUBLIC_* variable holding a key
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Only the public API URL is exposed; Gemini key, JWT secrets and the Mongo URI stay server-side

edge_cases.case: Tokens stored insecurely
edge_cases.trigger: Session persisted across app restarts
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Access and refresh tokens live in the OS secure store, not AsyncStorage

edge_cases.case: Account deletion
edge_cases.trigger: User taps Delete Account
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Two explicit confirmations naming what is removed; voice must never be able to trigger it
edge_cases.user_message: This will permanently remove your tasks and financial records.
